 Rs 377.71 Dividend, 1:1 Bonus Issue, Buybacks: 75 stocks to trade ex-date this week—Emami, HUL, ONGC on the list
 Written By Anubhav Maurya Published: 4:17 PM, Nov 8, 2026 | Updated: 6:35 PM, Nov 8, 2026 The coming week will see several companies announce corporate actions, including interim dividends, a bonus issue and share buybacks. According to the BSE corporate action calendar, 65 dividend announcements with specified dividend rates have been listed during the week. The combined total of their declared dividend rates comes to Rs 377.71 per share. The coming week will see several companies announce corporate actions. Image Credit: Canva With the Muhurat trading session now behind, the coming week will see several companies announce corporate actions, including interim dividends, a bonus issue and share buybacks. A number of listed companies have fixed their ex-dates between November 9 and November 13, 2026, giving investors a series of corporate actions to track.
 Companies such as Dabur India, ESAB India, Aurobindo Pharma, Balkrishna Industries, Chambal Fertilisers, Hindustan Unilever (HUL), Bayer CropScience, Godfrey Phillips India, Taparia Tools and Great Eastern Shipping Company are among those scheduled to trade ex-dividend next week.
 A total of 75 stocks are scheduled for corporate actions during the week from November 9 to November 13, 2026. These include 67 companies announcing dividends, one company announcing a bonus issue (Dharti Proteins), and two companies (Jyothy Labs and FDC) announcing share buybacks.
 Additionally, three companies have announced rights issues, while two InvITs have declared income distributions. The combined total of their declared dividend rates comes to Rs 377.71 per share.
 This is the sum of the individual per-share dividend rates and not the aggregate dividend payout by these companies, which depends on the number of eligible shares.
 Apart from dividends, Jyothy Labs and FDC have announced share buybacks, while Dharti Proteins has announced a 1:1 bonus issue.
 Dividend Stocks: November 9, 2026 
 Several companies will trade ex-dividend on Monday, November 9.
 Brisk Technovision has announced an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share, while Dabur India has declared an interim dividend of Rs 3.50 per share. ESAB India has announced one of the highest dividend rates in this group, at Rs 20 per share.
 Ganesh Consumer Products has declared an interim dividend of Rs 3.70 per share. Labelkraft Technologies and Metropolis Healthcare have announced dividends of Rs 1 per share each.
 Oswal Agro Mills and Saksoft have declared interim dividends of Rs 0.50 per share each.
 The record dates for these companies are November 9 or November 10, depending on the company.
 Dividend Stocks: November 11, 2026 
 Several prominent companies will trade ex-dividend on November 11.
 Aurobindo Pharma has announced an interim dividend of Rs 7 per share, while Balkrishna Industries and Balrampur Chini Mills have declared dividends of Rs 4 per share each.
 Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals has announced an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share. Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) has declared a dividend of Rs 1.90 per share.
 Galaxy Surfactants has announced an interim dividend of Rs 18 per share, while GPT Infraprojects has declared Rs 1 per share.
 Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) has announced an interim dividend of Rs 1.35 per share. JM Financial has declared Rs 1.65 per share, while Dr Lal PathLabs has announced Rs 5 per share.
 Navneet Education has declared two dividends: an interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per share and a special dividend of Rs 1.50 per share, taking the combined dividend to Rs 3 per share.
 Other companies announcing dividends include ADF Foods (Rs 0.60), NBCC (Rs 0.25), NRB Bearings (Rs 2.50), PDS (Rs 2.20), Premier Energies (Rs 0.50), RITES (Rs 1.90), SNL Bearings (Rs 6) and Sonata Software (Rs 1.25).
 Dividend Stocks: November 12, 2026 
 November 12 will see some of the biggest dividend announcements of the week.
 Bayer CropScience has announced an interim dividend of Rs 90 per share, the highest specified dividend rate in the list.
 Godfrey Phillips India has declared an interim dividend of Rs 10 per share, while Gujarat Pipavav Port has announced Rs 3 per share.
 Hindustan Unilever (HUL) has declared an interim dividend of Rs 19 per share. Indian Metals and Ferro Alloys and Insecticides (India) have announced dividends of Rs 5 per share each.
 GPT Healthcare has declared Rs 1 per share, while IRB Infrastructure Developers has announced Rs 0.05 per share.
 NLC India has declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per share. Safari Industries India has announced Rs 2 per share, while Taparia Tools has declared an interim dividend of Rs 40 per share.
 Gaja Alternative Asset Management has also announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share.
 Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has declared an interim dividend of Rs 8 per equity share (face value of Rs 5 each) for the financial year 2026–27 alongside its Q2 results.
 Dividend Stocks: November 13, 2026 
 The final trading day covered in the corporate action calendar will also see several companies trade ex-dividend.
 Great Eastern Shipping Company has announced an interim dividend of Rs 14.40 per share. Emami has declared Rs 5 per share, while Aptus Value Housing Finance India has announced Rs 2 per share.
 Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) has declared an interim dividend of Rs 3.25 per share. Astral and BMW Ventures have announced dividends of Rs 1.50 per share each.
 Dynamatic Technologies has declared Rs 2 per share, while Mafatlal Industries has announced Rs 1 per share.
 Other companies announcing dividends include Bhatia Communications (Rs 0.01), Mobavenue AI Tech (Rs 0.10), OCCL (Rs 2), Orient Technologies (Rs 2), Pearl Global Industries (Rs 5), PPAP Automotive (Rs 1.50), Precision Wires India (Rs 0.35), Premco Global (Rs 10), Rain Industries (Rs 0.50), Repco Home Finance (Rs 5), Shivalik Bimetal Controls (Rs 2), Somany Ceramics (Rs 6), SP Capital Financing (Rs 0.75), Star Cement (Rs 1), TAAL Tech (Rs 5), Techknowgreen Solutions (Rs 0.50) and Transworld Shipping Lines (Rs 11).
 IG Petrochemicals has also announced an Rs 10 interim dividend.
 Bonus Issue and Buyback: Other Corporate Actions Next Week 
 Apart from dividend announcements, investors will also track three other corporate actions.
 Dharti Proteins: The company has announced a 1:1 bonus issue, with November 13 fixed as the ex-date. Under the ratio, eligible shareholders will receive one additional share for every existing share held.
 Jyothy Labs: The company has announced a buyback of shares, with November 11 as the ex-date.
 FDC: The pharmaceutical company has also announced a share buyback, with November 13 as the ex-date.
